checks.lean: example {α : Type*} : Set α → Set α → Prop := T1.MyDisjoint

example : ¬ T1.DirectImagesPreserveIntersections T1.counterexampleMap := by
  intro h
  have eq := h {true} {false}
  have hm : true ∈ (T1.counterexampleMap '' {true}) ∩ (T1.counterexampleMap '' {false}) := by
    constructor
    · exact ⟨true, rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨false, rfl, rfl⟩
  rw [← eq] at hm
  simpa [T1.counterexampleMap] using hm
checks.message: The map and the two singleton sets must refute direct-image preservation of intersections.

hints.hint: Use `∀ x, x ∈ s → x ∈ t → False`.
Use `∀ x ∈ s, ∃ U ∈ C, x ∈ U`.
Conjoin two universally quantified equalities, one for `s ∪ t` and one for `s ∩ t`.
Use the constant map `fun _ => true`. The direct images of `{true}` and `{false}` meet, but the sets do not.
